name: Intruder Lalka ~Kangoku no Kotou~
original_name: イントルーダー・ラルカ～姦獄の孤島～
source:
The stage is set! A solitary island ruled by tyranny and assault, in the middle of the southern sea!
A spy adventure game following a female agent's lonely battle for justice!

Raruka, an international terrorist, has been imprisoned during a mission, and has been declared as killed in action.
However, the economical leader of Europe, duke Elberich, appears before her and declares that he has bought her life.

Her life saved because of her skills as a terrorist, Raruka is sent to a solitary island in the southern sea.

She is assigned the duty of rescuing a genius scientist held captive in the military complex Avalus Ypsi.
At first glance, it may look like a grand resort island, but in reality it is a giant weapon, stained by the taint of cruelty and violence.

Will Raruka be able to fulfill her mission without ending up dead!?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038979.html]Dlsite[/url]]
translation:
舞台已经搭好！南方海域中央，有一座由暴政与侵犯统治的孤岛！
一部间谍冒险游戏，讲述女特工为正义孤身奋战的故事！

国际恐怖分子拉尔卡在执行任务期间遭到囚禁，并被宣告已经阵亡。
然而，掌控欧洲经济命脉的埃尔贝里希公爵出现在她面前，声称自己买下了她的性命。

拉尔卡凭借恐怖分子的本领保住一命，随后被送往南方海域的一座孤岛。

她接到任务，要救出被关押在阿瓦鲁斯·伊普西军事设施中的天才科学家。
乍看之下，那里仿佛一座宏伟的度假岛，真实面目却是一件沾满残酷与暴力污秽的巨型兵器。

拉尔卡能在不丢掉性命的情况下完成任务吗！？
